comment: new_were() announces the change with Monnam(), which is mon_nam() raised to a capital: ARTICLE_THE, so a tame werecreature is 'The werewolf', not 'Your werewolf' (only y_monnam() uses ARTICLE_YOUR for pets). A scroll of taming tames the wolf-form werewolf created beside the hero (is_human() blocks taming only the @ form); were_change() then turns it human with its 1/30 chance while the hero searches. Independent seed, date and character.
